How do you coordinate large AI research teams to tackle complex societal challenges?

AIVO brought together project managers from 25 AI Institutes to share their experiences and help answer this question. Their new paper is now available online and offers practical recommendations for funding agencies, academic institutions, and research organizations on enabling effective team science.

Read the paper: https://lnkd.in/gsJSfKxb

AIVO supported this effort through convenings at conferences and by facilitating team science-focused activities over the past two years. We appreciate the leadership of Kevin Dalmeijer and Tim R. in bringing this collaborative effort across the finish line!

text:
⚖️ Innovation vs. Risk: Navigating the Ethics and Security of AI-Chemistry

As AI moves from "assistant" to "autonomous agent," the chemistry community faces a new set of existential questions. It’s no longer just about what we can make, but how we ensure these powerful tools are used safely and ethically.

At the 2026 MMLI Symposium in Atlanta, we are convening a powerhouse panel to tackle the "tough stuff"—the ethics and security of AI-driven chemical research.

🎤 Special Panel: Ethics and Security in AI-Chemistry Research

Moderator: 
🔹 Rachel Switzky (Director, Siebel Center for Design, UIUC / NSF-MMLI Thrust lead)

The Panelists: 
🔹 Prof. Martin D. Burke (NSF-MMLI / UIUC) – Pioneer of modular synthesis.
🔹 Dr. Andrew White (FutureHouse) – Expert in the automation of scientific discovery. 
🔹 Dr. Justin Smith (NVIDIA) – Leading the charge in AI computing and infrastructure. 
🔹 Dr. Mukund Chorgade (ThinkQ Pharma) – Bringing deep pharmaceutical and regulatory perspective. 

We’re moving past hypotheticals to discuss: 
📍 Where Risk Shows Up First: Is it in the tools, the workflows, or the institutions? 
🔒 The Limits of Openness: In a world of open-source science, is there information that has become "too fast" or "too dangerous" to share?
 🤝 Ownership of Harm: When an AI-driven system enables misuse or causes an accident, who is ultimately responsible? 
🤖 Autonomy Without Supervision: What happens when AI begins to design and iterate on experiments with limited human oversight?

The choices we make in the next year will set the norms for the next decade. 

Join us for this critical dialogue on how to build guardrails that actually hold up under real-world pressure.

📅 Date: March 23, 2026 
📍 Location: Georgia World Congress Center, Atlanta, GA 
🔗 See the full agenda & join the conversation: https://lnkd.in/g5ZCdtV6
